map.录入车辆保养明细（项目、里程、费用、4S店或汽修厂），按当前里程计算保养完整度评: Enter the vehicle maintenance history (items, mileage, cost, 4S dealer or garage) to compute a maintenance completeness score against the current mileage and estimate the effect on the used car residual value, with an exportable assessment report.
map.卖车前整理历次保养明细（项目、里程、费用、4S 店或汽修厂），量化保养完整度。: Before selling a car, organise the maintenance history (items, mileage, cost, 4S dealer or garage) to quantify maintenance completeness.
map.评估完整保养记录对二手车残值的增值影响，作为卖点包装依据。: Assess how complete maintenance records raise the used car's residual value, as evidence for the sales pitch.
map.生成可导出/打印的保养评估报告，向买家证明车况可信度。: Generate an exportable and printable maintenance assessment report to show buyers the vehicle's condition is credible.
map.以「当前里程 6 万 km、覆盖全部期望保养项目且均为 4S 店记录」为例: Take "current mileage 60,000 km, covering all expected maintenance items with 4S dealer records" as an example
map.：完整度评分按期望项目覆盖率计算（4S 店记录权重 1.0、汽修厂 0.85），: The completeness score is computed from the coverage of expected items (4S dealer records weight 1.0, garage 0.85); full coverage done properly gives score>90 and the grade "excellent". The residual value uplift is taken as +12.5%: for a vehicle valued at 100,000 the maintenance bonus is about +12,500, giving an adjusted residual of about 112,500. If only half the items are covered the score falls in the 50-70 range and the uplift is only +2.5% (+2,500).
map.二手车保值率/残值计算: Used Car Value Retention / Residual Value Calculator
map.完整度评分怎么影响残值？: How does the completeness score affect the residual value?
map.评分>90→残值+12.5%、≥70→+7.5%、≥50→+2.5%、否则-5%: A score above 90 gives residual value +12.5%, 70 or more +7.5%, 50 or more +2.5%, otherwise −5%. 4S dealer records carry more weight than ordinary garages (1.0 versus 0.85), and continuous, on-time records within the warranty mileage add more. These ratios are empirical reference only; the actual premium also depends on the brand and condition.
map.记录不全怎么办？: What if the records are incomplete?
map.可补录已知保养（注明来源），缺失项会拉低覆盖分；建议尽量补全 4S 电子记录或发: You can backfill known maintenance items (noting the source); missing items lower the coverage score, so fill in the 4S electronic records or invoices as far as possible. The tool accepts multiple entries and judges "already done" against the current mileage, so items not yet due do not count as missing.
